Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE landscape location-reference PNG, exactly 1536×1024, edge-to-edge, no collage or borders. Recipe: establish — visible location key light; full value range; full detailed drawn environment, with tiny figures only where explicitly requested.

All signs are plain empty signboards, no marks, glyphs, logos, posters or shop contents. The corridor is only 5 m wide, ceiling 2.8 m high, normal shop shutter openings 2.3 m high. Thin pale cold white-cyan #D8F4FF rim, dark black-violet #1A1026 interior, no portal ring, door frame or labels. The building is real and mundane; supernatural light confined to this slit and its immediate small reflection. Dust gathers at shutter feet, a few paper scraps without writing, no fog, no large dust cloud, no rain inside. Camera 1.6 m above floor, wide three-quarter establishing view along the arcade, horizon around the middle, one common vanishing system, squared architecture and believable shutter ribs. No people, no mannequins, no vehicles. Keep street stairs and any additional trap chamber OUTSIDE this frame; they belong to another entry. Full detailed drawn location key in muted cool grey/navy, crisp outlines and hard cel shadows; no photographic or CGI material.

The final attachment is the approved acting-style anchor: match its tapered crisp ink, clean opaque cel shadows, restrained light wash and drawn colour.
